name: Solar Panel Sizing
overview: Estimate the system capacity required for daily energy use.
practice: Model local sun hours, system losses and roof constraints.

name: Solar Production Calculator
overview: Translate installed kilowatts into estimated daily kilowatt-hours.
practice: Use site-specific irradiance and conservative performance assumptions.

name: Solar Installation Planning
overview: Understand roof layout, orientation, shade and structural checks.
practice: Require professional design review before installation.

name: Solar Return on Investment
overview: Calculate payback using upfront cost and estimated energy value.
practice: Include tariffs, maintenance, incentives and degradation.

name: Solar Inverter Sizing
overview: Compare inverter capacity, surge limits and system topology.
practice: Verify voltage compatibility and manufacturer specifications.

name: Solar Panel Comparison
overview: Compare panel rated wattage, dimensions, warranties and degradation.
practice: Use standardized test conditions to compare efficiency claims.

name: Residential Electricity Bills
overview: Understand energy-unit charges, demand costs and fixed fees.
practice: Use an actual local bill instead of assuming a universal tariff.

name: Electricity Tariffs
overview: Learn how utility pricing tiers and time-of-use rates work.
practice: Check official effective dates and service territory.

name: Appliance Energy Costs
overview: Calculate electricity use from wattage and operating hours.
practice: Consider duty cycles for devices that do not run continuously.

name: Energy Saving Planner
overview: Identify high-use loads and prioritize efficiency measures.
practice: Compare avoided kilowatt-hours against replacement costs.

name: Battery Backup Calculator
overview: Estimate usable capacity for an outage duration.
practice: Account for depth of discharge, inverter loss and surge loads.

name: Lithium vs Lead-acid
overview: Understand battery chemistry trade-offs and cycle life.
practice: Compare usable energy and safe installation requirements.

name: UPS Runtime
overview: Estimate backup duration at specified load and efficiency.
practice: Confirm rated capacity and battery condition.

name: Generator Sizing
overview: Evaluate continuous watts and short-duration starting power.
practice: Observe exhaust ventilation and electrical safety rules.

name: Commercial Energy Audit
overview: Organize demand profiles, equipment loads and peak usage.
practice: Base savings estimates on measured energy consumption.

name: EV Charging Cost
overview: Calculate cost from kilowatt-hours, charging efficiency and tariff.
practice: Separate home, workplace and public charger pricing.

name: EV Range Estimator
overview: Estimate driving distance from usable battery and consumption.
practice: Adjust for temperature, speed, terrain and accessory loads.

name: EV Battery Health
overview: Understand capacity retention, cycle aging and thermal effects.
practice: Use vehicle telemetry rather than visual guesswork.

name: EV vs Petrol Costs
overview: Compare energy and fuel spending per distance traveled.
practice: Include maintenance, taxes and depreciation separately.

name: Home Charger Installation
overview: Review circuit capacity, charger ratings and safety.
practice: Follow local electrical code and licensed installer requirements.

name: Public Charging Networks
overview: Compare connector standards, charger power and access.
practice: Check real availability through provider data where supported.

name: E-bike Range
overview: Estimate bicycle battery range under different loads.
practice: Consider rider assistance, wind, hills and riding style.

name: Vehicle Fuel Cost
overview: Calculate journey fuel cost from distance and consumption.
practice: Use actual pump prices and consistent units.

name: Car Ownership Cost
overview: Organize purchase, insurance, financing and maintenance costs.
practice: Compare annualized expenses, not purchase price alone.

name: Vehicle Maintenance
overview: Track service intervals, consumables and inspection priorities.
practice: Refer to your vehicle manufacturer's schedule.

name: Home Power Load
overview: Add appliance loads for inverter and circuit planning.
practice: Allow headroom and account for startup surge.

name: Wind & Hybrid Energy
overview: Explore combining wind, solar and battery systems.
practice: Compare seasonal output profiles before designing hybrid capacity.

name: Energy Storage Economics
overview: Analyze battery replacement and daily cycling economics.
practice: Include round-trip losses, warranty cycles and tariff structure.

name: Grid & Net Metering
overview: Understand grid export rules and settlement arrangements.
practice: Confirm current eligibility with the local utility.

name: Clean Energy Trends
overview: Follow renewable technology economics and public data.
practice: Date-source all cost and deployment figures.
